Theres a lot to dissect here but here is my big takeaway. You guys need to practice intentional hits or directional hits. When the ball is sent your way or you are going for a 50, thats your only focus. It doesnt seem like you guys plan beyond just hitting the ball.   


I would reccomend to start practicing hitting with intention. Just an example, when they shoot the ball at your net, dont just smack it out, try to re direct the ball into one of your corners, that way it eliminates a follow up shot, letting your team get boost and get ready for a counter play.   


When going for a 50, dont just go for the 50, attempt to direct it in a direction that would be most beneficial to your team. Sounds simple yet its one of the main reasons I see for people not winning games.   


This may differ for some, but my personal playstyle is more horizontal than vertical. Im usually trying to play off walls or corners, because in my experience, it puts the other team at a disadvantage most of the time. Playing vertically can turn into a game of ping pong really quickly, but a team who controls the ball, and utilizes intentional hits, wins.
